title: Administrator
description:
Administrator - Drylining Subcontractor

We are looking for an organised and reliable Administrator to join our busy drylining subcontracting business.

The role will involve supporting the day-to-day running of the office, including general administration, raising invoices, processing timesheets, preparing paperwork, answering emails and phones, updating records, and assisting the contracts/project team.

About you
- Previous administration experience, ideally within construction or a similar environment
- Good organisational and communication skills
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Strong attention to detail and ability to work to deadlines
- Reliable, proactive and able to work independently
- Construction industry experience would be an advantage but is not essential

Location: Barnsley
Hours: 40 hours per week
Salary: 30k Per annum

If you are looking for a varied role within a friendly and fast-paced construction business, we would love to hear from you

title: Administrator
description:
We are currently recruiting for an Administrator to join our client's busy operational team based in Barnsley.

This is a varied role supporting the day-to-day running of a Highways Lighting and New Business team. You'll play an important part in keeping work organised and on track, from scheduling and coordinating activities through to maintaining documentation, updating systems and supporting customers.

We're looking for someone who is organised, proactive and confident working in a fast-paced environment. Previous experience within utilities, highways, street lighting, engineering or construction would be advantageous, although strong administration or customer service experience is the main requirement.

What you'll be doing
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the operational team.
- Scheduling, coordinating and tracking work using internal systems.
- Preparing and maintaining documentation and accurate records.
- Raising purchase orders and processing invoices.
- Keeping systems and data accurate and up to date.
- Handling customer queries and supporting the resolution of issues and complaints.
- Communicating with colleagues, customers and external stakeholders.
- Monitoring workloads and deadlines to ensure customer requirements are met.
- Supporting the coordination of works, engineers, field teams or appointments.
- Gathering information and following issues through to resolution.
- Supporting continuous improvements to processes and ways of working.

What we're looking for
- Previous experience within administration and/or customer service.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload.
- Good Microsoft Office and general IT skills.
- Confidence learning and using new systems.
- Excellent attention to detail when working with documentation, records and data.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- A professional and customer-focused approach.
- Good problem-solving skills with the ability to take ownership of issues.
- The ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Good numerical skills and confidence working with information and data.
- A positive, proactive and enthusiastic approach.

Desirable experience

It would be particularly beneficial if you have:
- Experience within utilities, highways, street lighting, energy, engineering, construction or a similar operational environment.
- Experience raising purchase orders and processing invoices.
- Experience using asset management, works management or scheduling systems.
- Experience coordinating works, engineers, field teams or appointments.
- Knowledge of Street Works or permitting processes.
- An NVQ Level 2 in Business Administration, Customer Service or a similar qualification.

Rullion celebrates and supports diversity and is committed to ensuring equal opportunities for both employees and applicants.

title: Administrator
description:
Project Administrator

Doncaster

£28,000 per annum

Are you an Administrator with experience working in the construction sector?

Are you looking for a permanent position in Barnsley?

TS Recruitment are recruiting for an office administrator in Barnsley for a growing construction contractor.

Benefits
- Basic salary circa £28,000 per annum
- 40 hour working week
- Free Parking

Job Role & Responsibilities of the Administrator:
- Work closely with Quantity Surveyors, Contracts Managers and Directors to offer admin and supply chain support
- All office admin for a construction company including logging and scheduling work
- Liaise with suppliers to order materials and check lead times
- Input purchase orders onto the system
- Site set up, including H&S files, signage and site folders
- Book accommodation and travel arrangements if needed
- Get prices from suppliers and agree delivery schedules
- Update Site Managers on delivery dates and times
- Review and check timesheets
- Ensure all paperwork is in order including health and safety documents
- Ensure the supply chain runs smoothly
- Answer telephone and respond to emails

Company Details
- Barnsley based regional construction contractor
- Recruiting due to continued growth
- Regular repeat clients
- Potential for career growth / advancement

Knowledge/Experience:
- Experience working as an administrator (preferably in construction)
- Proficient in Microsoft, including Excel and Word
- Good communicator both verbally and electronically

Applications

If you feel that you have the relevant experience to be successful in this position and would like to find out more, please apply online today attaching a copy of your current CV.

Due to the vast number of applications that we receive, it is not possible for us to contact all applicants; therefore, only suitable candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear anything back within 7 days of submitting your application, you have unfortunately not been selected.

TSR are an Equal Opportunities employer. All applications will be dealt with in the strictest confidence.

title: Medical Receptionist
description:

- Do you have GP experience

If you are a proactive individual with a passion for delivering high-quality patient care through efficient administrative support,

We welcome your application for the Medical Receptionist position.

title: Next Day Tracking Coordinators
description:
The Recruitment Crowd are currently recruiting Next Day Tracking Coordinators to join the team at EVRi in Barnsley.

Hours: 4 on 4 off, 6pm starts

Pay Rate: 12.42 per hour PAYE

Location: Barnsley (S74)

Job Type: Ongoing

The role:
- Tracking vehicles, predominantly for Next Day collections, to ensure that they are running on time.
- Recording timings on to the tracking/collection report.
- Liaising with clients to inform them of any delays
- Contacting drivers to confirm ETA's, reasons for late arrivals, late departures etc.
- Filing of documents ie. Maps
- General admin duties

Requirements:
- Candidate needs to have understanding of systems such as MS Excel
- Be computer literate
- Be comfortable speaking and calling drivers
- Experience in a similar work environment
- Be able to work the required shift pattern of 4 on 4 off

For more information, please apply directly with a copy of your CV today and a member of our team will be in touch!
